# fastapi/openapi/docs.py:26  (fastapi.openapi.docs.get_swagger_ui_html)
```python
(function) def get_swagger_ui_html(
    *,
    openapi_url: str,
    title: str,
    swagger_js_url: str = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swa",
    swagger_css_url: str = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swa",
    swagger_favicon_url: str = "https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/img",
    oauth2_redirect_url: str | None = None,
    init_oauth: Dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    swagger_ui_parameters: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
) -> HTMLResponse
```
---
Generate and return the HTML  that loads Swagger UI for the interactive
API docs (normally served at `/docs`).

You would only call this function yourself if you needed to override some parts,
for example the URLs to use to load Swagger UI's JavaScript and CSS.

Read more about it in the  
[FastAPI docs for Configure Swagger UI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/configure-swagger-ui/)  
and the [FastAPI docs for Custom Docs UI Static Assets (Self-Hosting)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/custom-docs-ui-assets/).

# fastapi/encoders.py:102  (fastapi.encoders.jsonable_encoder)
```python
(function) def jsonable_encoder(
    obj: Any,
    include: IncEx | None = None,
    exclude: IncEx | None = None,
    by_alias: bool = True,
    exclude_unset: bool = False,
    exclude_defaults: bool = False,
    exclude_none: bool = False,
    custom_encoder: Dict[Any, (Any) -> Any] | None = None,
    sqlalchemy_safe: bool = True
) -> Any
```
---
Convert any object to something that can be encoded in JSON.

This is used internally by FastAPI to make sure anything you return can be
encoded as JSON before it is sent to the client.

You can also use it yourself, for example to convert objects before saving them
in a database that supports only JSON.

Read more about it in the  
[FastAPI docs for JSON Compatible Encoder](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/encoder/).

definitions outside the repository (typeshed, site-packages) are not followed
an outline item (lsp_symbol) names every symbol it lists

You are investigating fastapi/openapi/docs.py's Swagger UI page generation. ## Response format

Respond with a single fenced JSON object and nothing else:
```json
{"reasoning": "<short explanation>", "symbols": ["<fully.qualified.name>", "..."]}
```
`symbols` lists every code symbol that is part of your answer, in order, by exact fully-qualified name.
